author: Middle Man
text_post: How will braces affect my game? I'm 21 years old, going on 22 and new to the game. I am currently in need of braces and I was wondering if anyone has any experience on how this will effect my game. Just so you all know, my teeth aren't that bad but there are some crooked ones that I would like to have fixed, so this is a totally optional procedure, but I think it will help my smile and of course I am concerned about my dental health. Will women take my having braces in a bad way or a good?

author: Flex88
text_post: Thats good your taking care of it now man, I know some people with bad teeth who wont get braces because they think it will effect their looks and chances with girls etc which is stupid. Theres different types of braces these days which are becoming much less noticeable. Lots of women have had braces - if you want you could even run the subject as an opener, other women might think you look like a 14yr old... but after them braces are off you'll be very grateful for your decision.

author: Middle Man
text_post: An opener... Hm, I never thought about using it that way. Thanks for the idea. I actually plan on going with the most inconspicous braces I can get and hopefully I won't have to wear them for very long.

author: Exclusive_
text_post: Do it! I have had my braces on for over a month and its one of the best decisions of my life. (I'm 21, senior in college). If you go ceramic or invisalign (I went ceramic) people will hardly notice. If they do, your acting confident with it will only increase your value. If you're wondering 'How the hell am I going to be confident about my braces?!' Its simple. By getting braces you are taking a major step to improving your quality of life. People respect that. You will FEEL that respect instantly with the people close to you. That respect transforms into legitimate confidence about your situation, which will radiate from you when you meet new people, especially women.
